name: skill-forge
title_zh: 从一句话需求到可上架 Skill 的完整流水线
tagline_zh: 别人给你的是灵感碎片，它给你的是架构决策、提示词边界、打包规范。照着走，产出的 Skill 能过官方审核，不是玩具。
tagline_en: Turns vague inspiration into architecture, prompt boundaries, and packaging rules. Follow it and your Skill.
desc_en: Create high-quality, production-grade skills for Claude Code. Expert guidance on skill architecture, workflow design, prompt engineering, and packaging. Use when user wants to create a new skill, build a skill, design a skill, write a skill, update an existing skill, improve a skill, refactor a skill, debug a skill, or package a skill. Triggers: 'create skill', 'build skill', 'new skill', 'skill c
why_zh: 它把 Skill 开发拆成显式阶段，每步有检查点，逼你先把触发词和失败路径想清楚再写代码。
why_en: Forces explicit stages with checkpoints: triggers and failure modes before code. No more duct-tape skills that break on edge.
limit_zh: 只服务 Claude Code 的 Skill 格式，不生成 MCP server 或独立 CLI。
limit_en: Claude Code Skills only; no MCP or CLI. Needs your own idea—won't invent one. Outputs spec + skeleton, not a debugged runtime.
title_en: From one-line idea to a shippable Claude Code Skill
